quote: 1. He who has money can speculate. He who has no money must not speculate. But he who has neither money nor patience should stay clear of the stock exchange altogether.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 2. Ideas are like children: none as beautiful as your own.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 3. Acquire worldly wisdom and adjust your behavior accordingly.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 4. Forecasts may tell you a great deal about the forecaster; they tell you nothing about the future.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 5. Someone will always be getting richer faster than you. This is not a tragedy.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 6. Investment success doesn't come from 'buying good things,' but from 'buying things well.'
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 7. Mimicking the herd invites regression to the mean.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 8. Resisting - and thereby succeeding as a contrarian - requires the ability to withstand pain.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 9. There are only three ways to lose money: women, gambling, and technical analysis. My preference goes to the third method: it is the most reliable one.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 10. You only have to do a very few things right in your life so long as you don't do too many things wrong.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 11. Financial markets generally are unpredictable.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 12. The stock market can never be understood 100 percent. It must remain a mystery, as is true of many things in life.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 13. The most important three words in investing are margin of safety.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 14. Invert, always invert.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 15. I insist upon a right to be wrong.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 16. In my whole life, I have known no wise people who didn't read all the time – none, zero.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 17. The worse a situation becomes, the less it takes to turn it around, and the bigger the upside.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 18. In investing, what is comfortable is rarely profitable.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 19. Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 20. You must know the big ideas in the big disciplines and use them routinely – all of them, not just a few.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 21. The whole stock market depends only on whether there are more shares than idiots or more idiots than shares.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 22. If you don't feel comfortable owning something for 10 years, then don't own it for 10 minutes.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 23. Being too far ahead of your time is indistinguishable from being wrong.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 24. It is waste of time to keep going over the past instead of using the energy to change the future.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 25. The desire to get rich fast is pretty dangerous.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 26. Experience is what you got when you didn't get what you wanted.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 27. Buy stocks, take sleeping pills, and don't look at the prices.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 28. Take a simple idea and take it seriously.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 29. All intelligent investing is value investing — acquiring more than you are paying for.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 30. Whoever wants to become rich quickly will die poor.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 31. You're paying less to brokers, you're listening to less nonsense, and if it works, the tax system gives you an extra one, two, or three percentage points per annum.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 32. You can't predict. You can prepare.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 33. I'm only rich because I know when I'm wrong.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 34. The most important quality for an investor is temperament, not intellect.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 35. Markets are constantly in a state of uncertainty and flux, and money is made by discounting the obvious and betting on the unexpected.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 36. In the absence of something needing to be paid for, price and value can diverge substantially.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 37. Our favorite holding period is forever.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 38. Reflexivity is a two-way feedback mechanism in which reality helps shape the participants' thinking and the participants' thinking helps shape reality.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 39. Money that is easily made is easily lost.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 40. In the business world, the rearview mirror is always clearer than the windshield.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 41. The big money is not in the buying and selling, but in the waiting.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 42. It's not whether you're right or wrong, but how much money you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 43. Risk comes from not knowing what you are doing.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 44. Knowing what you don't know is more useful than being brilliant.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 45. Money is never lost, it is simply transferred from one pocket to another.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 46. The best investment you can make is in yourself.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 47. I'm not in the game to disprove or prove some hypothesis; I'm in it to make money.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 48. The stock market is 90 percent psychology.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 49. Spend each day trying to be a little wiser than you were when you woke up.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 50. My approach works not by making valid predictions but by allowing me to correct false ones.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 51. A speculator is one who observes the future and acts before it occurs.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 52. It's not supposed to be easy. Anyone who finds it easy is stupid.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 53. There's nothing wrong with a forecast that turns out to be dead wrong. What's wrong is believing in it in the first place.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 54. Anyone who is not a millionaire but has one million in debt is a millionaire.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 55. Be fearful when others are greedy and greedy when others are fearful.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 56. It is not necessary to do extraordinary things to get extraordinary results.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 57. The safest way to try to get what you want is to try to deserve what you want. It's such a simple idea.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 58. You can't do the same things others do and expect to outperform.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 59. All I want to know is where I'm going to die, so I'll never go there.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 60. Rule number one: most things will prove to be cyclical. Rule number two: some of the greatest opportunities for gain and loss come when other people forget rule number one.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 61. Anyone who doesn't possess shares should buy some; anyone who already has shares should hold on to them; and anyone who has neither shares nor money should sell his shirt and buy shares.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 62. Markets are always wrong in the sense that they present a biased view of the future.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 63. Money made on the stock exchange is like a loan – you have to give it back sooner or later.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 64. It's far better to buy a wonderful company at a fair price than a fair company at a wonderful price.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 65. It is remarkable how much long-term advantage people like us have gotten by trying to be consistently not stupid, instead of trying to be very intelligent.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 66. The stock market is not, however, a mere mirror; it is a distorting mirror.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 67. The first rule of fishing is to fish where the fish are. The second rule of fishing is to never forget the first rule.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 68. The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 69. My financial success stands in stark contrast with my ability to forecast events.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 70. Rule No. 1: Never lose money. Rule No. 2: Never forget rule No. 1.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 71. Should you find yourself in a chronically leaking boat, energy devoted to changing vessels is likely to be more productive than energy devoted to patching leaks.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 72. He who understands, does not speculate; he who speculates, does not understand.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 73. It takes 20 years to build a reputation and five minutes to ruin it.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 74. If you're not willing to react with equanimity to a market price decline of 50% two or three times a century, you're not fit to be a common shareholder.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 75. Never forget the six-foot-tall man who drowned crossing the stream that was five feet deep on average.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 76. Diversification is protection against ignorance. It makes little sense if you know what you are doing.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 77. When I see a bubble forming, I rush in to buy, adding fuel to the fire.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 78. There are only two things that can happen on the stock market: it goes up, or it goes down.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 79. Games are won by players who focus on the playing field – not by those whose eyes are glued to the scoreboard.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 80. I made most of my money out of bear markets rather than bull markets.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 81. Money is like soap: the more you touch it, the smaller it becomes.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 82. Never invest in a business you cannot understand.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 83. Only when the tide goes out do you discover who's been swimming naked.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 84. Once we realize that imperfect understanding is the human condition there is no shame in being wrong, only in failing to correct our mistakes.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 85. Time is the friend of the wonderful business, the enemy of the mediocre.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 86. You don't have to be brilliant, only a little bit wiser than the other guys, on average, for a long, long time.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 87. The riskiest thing in the world is the belief that there's no risk.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 88. Chains of habit are too light to be felt until they are too heavy to be broken.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 89. Well, I don't play the game by a particular set of rules; I look for changes in the rules of the game.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 90. In my sixty years on the stock market, I have seen much more money disappear due to overreaction than disappear due to inflation.
speaker: André Kostolany
